verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a self-serve sandbox that is completely separate from production, covers all products, and has per-product simulation docs. AI agents get direct sandbox access through the Developer MCP (mcp.sandbox.airwallex.com), which can create test resources and simulate events, and through the CLI, which defaults to sandbox and needs an explicit --prod opt-in. missing for 10: sandbox coverage of Connected Account APIs (explicitly excluded), independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox behavior.
